concepts.name: Machine Epistemics
concepts.plain_definition: A proposed higher-order science of machine-mediated scientific-state change across mature parent sciences.
required_promotion: at least two materially different domains
concepts.falsifier: F0/F1/F3 explains the protected decisions without a stable cross-parent residual.

concepts.name: Absorptive supertheory
concepts.plain_definition: A federated higher-order theory that recovers parent-native judgments, formalizes cross-parent relations, generates new consequences and outperforms the strongest parent federation on protected problems.
concepts.falsifier: Strongest parent federation is equivalent or superior, or F2 loses native validity/authority distinctions.

concepts.name: Scientific knowledge metabolism
concepts.plain_definition: A measurable lifecycle of decomposition, native recovery, reduction, recombination, challenge and selective assimilation/reopening.
inspiration_sources: scientific donor reduction and problem-solving parents
concepts.falsifier: Lifecycle components do not change protected outcomes beyond simple/F0 controls or add unacceptable drag.
concepts.allowed_wording: operational lifecycle hypothesis inspired by metabolism/recycling metaphors

concepts.name: Machine-native scientific intelligence
concepts.plain_definition: Scientific problem solving that uses substrate-relative internal representations/search while retaining claim-sufficient external scientific witnesses.
concepts.falsifier: Gain is explained by compute, leakage, opacity or parent method; mechanism fails to transfer or cannot support external scientific validation.

concepts.name: Scientific warrant factorisation
concepts.plain_definition: A candidate formal account in which scientific transition warrant depends on heterogeneous links such as source identity, model adequacy, numerical validity, evaluator adequacy, dependence, argument, transport and authority.
required_promotion: nontrivial theorem/impossibility/counterexample or protected empirical residual
concepts.falsifier: Mature assurance/argumentation composition expresses all registered cases without the proposed factorisation.

concepts.name: Epistemic action modes
concepts.plain_definition: A typed distinction among confirmatory, discriminative, exploratory, constructive, calibrative and replicative actions so their outputs are not granted the wrong inferential authority.
required_promotion: inter-rater reliability or executable classification rule
concepts.falsifier: Existing parent distinctions or simpler labels preserve all protected decisions without the ORION interface.

concepts.name: TestSensitivityProfile
concepts.plain_definition: A claim-relative record of which relevant errors a test/evaluator can expose and its known blind spots.
required_promotion: cases where evaluator identity alone fails
concepts.falsifier: Existing test-sensitivity methods provide the same protected decision with no need for a stable cross-domain interface.

concepts.name: BoundaryInterfaceReceipt
concepts.plain_definition: A record of shared identity, local projections, limited common invariants, translation loss and prohibited cross-practice inferences.
concepts.falsifier: A simpler native interface or mature semantic-interoperability method preserves all decisions.

concepts.name: InductiveBiasDeclaration
concepts.plain_definition: A declaration of representation, prior/regularization, search order, assumed problem family, resource regime and known failure strata for a reasoning method.
required_promotion: predictive value for method/task fit or failure
concepts.falsifier: The declaration adds no predictive or decision value beyond ordinary model/method documentation.
